title: An Act to Ensure Uniformity in the Regulation of Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances in Pesticides

summary.text: This bill changes the definition of "perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances," also referred to as PFAS, in the Maine Pesticide Control Act of 1975 to align with the United States Environmental Protection Agency's definition of "PFAS." The bill also applies this definition of PFAS for the purposes of the prohibition on the sale of pesticide products containing intentionally added PFAS.
